text:
morgan: Heads up - customer-omega (private VPC) is seeing intermittent KMS decrypt failures and keystore-proxy 504s, pods restarted once. Observed around 08:17 UTC. Posting logs excerpt from keystore-proxy sidecar. :eyes:

morgan: ```
2024-08-21T08:17:03Z keystore-proxy ERROR decrypt request timeout id=abc123 backend=awskms status=504
2024-08-21T08:17:08Z keystore-proxy WARN retrying decrypt id=abc123 attempt=2
2024-08-21T08:17:18Z keystore-proxy ERROR decrypt failed id=abc123 error="dial tcp: i/o timeout"
```

morgan: This is an on-prem-ish customer (VPC peers to our control plane). They recently tightened egress netpols. Could be related or IAM role scoping.

priya: Is this limited to that customer/cluster?

morgan: So far only customer-omega. We reproduced by tightening egress in staging to match their netpol and saw similar timeouts.

sam: Probable cause: keystore-proxy needs to reach KMS endpoint and our audit-ingest (datadog/splunk). If netpols block egress or DNS, decrypts hang until TCP timeout. We rolled a change last week that default-netpols deny egress by default.

priya: Two vectors: 1) network policy exceptions (allow egress to KMS endpoints & logging), 2) RBAC/SA permissions - ensure keystore-proxy SA only has kms:Decrypt and sts:AssumeRole if cross-account.

morgan: Customers don't want 0.0.0.0/0 egress. Minimal IPs/hostnames to document?

sam: Prefer FQDN-based egress via CNI egress proxy or DNS policies. Hostnames: kms.us-east-1.amazonaws.com or private VPC endpoint IPs. For on-prem HSM allow HSM mgmt IPs. Example NetworkPolicy that worked in staging:

sam: ```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: keystore-egress-only
  namespace: redwood-keystore
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: keystore-proxy
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.10.100.0/24   # company VPC endpoint range
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          logging: allowed
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
```

priya: Add annotation on keystore-proxy deployment to emit verbose audit logs for decrypt failures: `keystore.redwood.io/audit=high`.

morgan: Should we change RBAC to require explicit RoleBinding for keystore-proxy SA instead of cluster-wide permissive bindings?

priya: Yes - tighten SA scope. Make a namespace-scoped Role with minimal secrets permissions and a custom permission for keystore API. Keep KMS permissions external (IAM).

sam: Operational note: current retry logic retries up to 30s which pushes callers into latency SLO breaches. Modify retry policy and surface metrics (keystore_proxy.decrypt.latency, keystore_proxy.decrypt.failures) and alerts.

morgan: I added emergency netpol exception for customer-omega (VPC endpoint + splunk ingest) and saw immediate stability. We should publish a hardened recommendation doc + minimal k8s policy bundle.

taylor: Triage: categorize sev-2. Runbook step: if keystore-proxy 5xx spike -> check netpols -> check DNS to KMS -> check IAM assume logs -> escalate. Can someone open JIRA with steps + owners?

morgan: Created SEC-2148 https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SEC-2148. Assigning sam for netpol bundle, priya for RBAC/audit, taylor for runbook/alerts.

priya: Audit logging: decrypt events should include principal, namespace, pod, request_id, proxied flag, and ship to tamper-evident store with 90d retention for private deployments. Add control-plane flag to toggle high-fidelity audit (default off).

sam: For private/VPC customers recommend either: 1) VPC endpoint for KMS + route table entries, or 2) tightly-scoped NAT/IP allowlist + egress-proxy. For on-prem HSM, integrate keystore adapter speaking PKCS11 and open netpol to HSM mgmt port 15000.

sec-bot: [Automated] Alert linked: SEC-2148 created by morgan. Status: investigating. Related alerts: keystore_proxy.decrypt.failures (spike), netpol.denied_egress (seen).

morgan: Action items summary:
- sam: publish `keystore-netpol-bundle.yaml` w/ FQDN/IP examples and test matrix (due EOD Tue)
- priya: prepare RBAC Role/RoleBinding templates + audit flag proposal (due Wed)
- taylor: update runbook + add alerts to console (due Wed)
- morgan: coordinate with customer-omega, verify staging patch (done)

priya: Security check - avoid leaking KMS ARNs in pod logs. Mask request metadata except request_id and anonymized principal.

sam: Quick incident check command: `kubectl exec -n redwood-keystore -it deploy/keystore-proxy -- curl -vs https://kms.internal.example.com/health`

morgan: We'll do a short sync tomorrow 14:00 UTC to walk through the netpol bundle before publishing. :thumbsup:
